crossRefs.note: He awoke, and rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, “Peace! Be still!” The wind ceased, and there was a great calm.
The floods have lifted up, Yahweh, the floods have lifted up their voice. The floods lift up their waves.
Above the voices of many waters, the mighty breakers of the sea, Yahweh on high is mighty.
Then they cry to Yahweh in their trouble, and he brings them out of their distress.
He said to them, “Why are you fearful, O you of little faith?” Then he got up, rebuked the wind and the sea, and there…
The men marveled, saying, “What kind of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”
Peter answered him and said, “Lord, if it is you, command me to come to you on the waters.”
They came to him, and awoke him, saying, “Master, master, we are dying!” He awoke, and rebuked the wind and the raging…
He said to them, “Where is your faith?” Being afraid they marveled, saying to one another, “Who is this then, that he…
They were willing therefore to receive him into the boat. Immediately the boat was at the land where they were going.
They were all amazed, so that they questioned among themselves, saying, “What is this? A new teaching? For with…
He arose, and immediately took up the mat, and went out in front of them all; so that they were all amazed, and…
They were greatly afraid, and said to one another, “Who then is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”
Immediately the girl rose up and walked, for she was twelve years old. They were amazed with great amazement.
They were astonished beyond measure, saying, “He has done all things well. He makes even the deaf hear, and the mute…

parallels.note: When they got up into the boat, the wind ceased.

translations.web: He got into the boat with them; and the wind ceased, and they were very amazed among themselves, and marveled;
translations.bsb: Then He climbed into the boat with them, and the wind died down. And the disciples were utterly astounded,
translations.kjv: And he went up unto them into the ship; and the wind ceased: and they were sore amazed in themselves beyond measure, and wondered.
translations.asv: And he went up unto them into the boat; and the wind ceased: and they were sore amazed in themselves;
